objective: Nghe một nhà nghiên cứu trình bày kết quả khảo sát về giấc ngủ của sinh viên, nắm các số liệu chính và nhận ra số liệu người nói tự sửa lại.

sentences.text: Today I am going to present the results of a survey into the sleep habits of university students.
The survey was carried out last spring at three universities in the north of England.
We received responses from 1,200 students — in fact, let me give you the exact figure: 1,240 students completed the full questionnaire.
On weekdays, students slept for an average of six hours and forty minutes per night.
At weekends the average rose to just over eight hours, as students tried to catch up on lost sleep.
Before examinations, the picture changed sharply: 38 per cent of students reported sleeping for less than six hours a night.
Students who went to bed at roughly the same time every night said they could concentrate better in lectures.
I should mention two limitations of the study, because all the figures are based on what students told us, and people often overestimate how much they sleep.
Also, the sample covered only three universities, so we should be careful about generalising the results.
In a follow-up study, we plan to compare the questionnaire answers with data from sleep-tracking devices.
Finally, our memory tests showed that students with irregular sleep schedules performed worse than regular sleepers, even when both groups slept for the same total number of hours.

evidence.quote: We received responses from 1,200 students — in fact, let me give you the exact figure: 1,240 students completed the full questionnaire.

explanation.trap: Người nói tự sửa số liệu ngay trong câu: 1.200 là con số nói vội ban đầu, con số chính xác là 1.240.

explanation.whyWrong: 1.200 là số chưa sửa. 1.420 không xuất hiện, còn 240 chỉ là phần đuôi của con số đúng.

evidence.quote: On weekdays, students slept for an average of six hours and forty minutes per night.

explanation.whyCorrect: Thời lượng ngủ trung bình ngày thường là sáu giờ bốn mươi phút mỗi đêm.
explanation.whyWrong: Tám giờ là mức trung bình cuối tuần; năm mươi phút không hề được nhắc trong bài.

sentences.text: Last month we ran a much smaller follow-up survey, this time about how students use the library during the exam period.
Three hundred students from the same three universities took part.
The survey ran for four weeks — no, I should correct that: it ran for five weeks, because we added an extra week during the exams themselves.
Most students told us they preferred to work in the library in the evening, when the building was quieter.
The most common reason for visiting was not borrowing books, but finding a desk away from the noise of shared houses.
Interestingly, only 12 per cent of the students said they used the library's online catalogue before visiting.
